data.name: The Christmas Tree Crawl: The Magic of Chicago at the Holidays
data.headline: Let's see all the best decorations before they're gone!
data.description: Inside Chicago Walking Tours leads a festive, nostalgic stroll through downtown Chicago to showcase the city’s best holiday decorations and traditions. This limited-time pop-up tour visits iconic stops like the Christkindlmarkt and the old Marshall Field’s as well as lesser-known sites, guiding guests to impressive indoor and outdoor Christmas trees while sharing the history behind beloved holiday characters and customs. Perfect for families and friends, the walk blends culture, history and seasonal sights with opportunities for photos and warming stops inside select buildings.
data.highlights:
* See beautiful building interiors and impressive Christmas trees
* Photograph the city’s most festive holiday displays
* Experience the authentic Christkindlmarkt in the USA
* Learn the history of famous Christmas characters and traditions

meeting_point.address: 400 N. Michigan Avenue Chicago, IL US 60611

data.cancellation_summary: Runs rain or shine; tour may be canceled with notice for particularly unpleasant weather.
data.cancellation_notes:
If tour is cancelled due to miserable weather (i.e., slushy rain, etc.), we will decide with as much notice as possible and refund or allow a credit toward a different tour with us.  We would prefer to cancel rather than force guests to have an experience dampened by bad weather, but we also want to wait until we know for sure that the weather will be a real problem.  We try to do our best to navigate that window!

Guests wishing to cancel of their own accord must cancel with more than 72 hours' notice for a full refund.
data.booking_notes:
###What to Bring:

 - Comfortable, warm clothing and shoes
 - Camera
 - Umbrella if you'll need it
 - Extra cash if you'd like to tip your guide
_______

###Please arrive at least 5 minutes prior to the scheduled tour time.  Your guide will be standing in the walk-through plaza between the two halves of the Wrigley Building.  The Wrigley Building is actually two buildings -- 400 N. Michigan Avenue and 410 N. Michigan Avenue -- and your guide will meet you in the plaza BETWEEN the two halves, away from the crowds on Michigan Avenue.
data.check_in_details: Meet outside the Peet's Coffee Shop in the Wrigley Building (400 N. Michigan Avenue). The Peet's is in the walk-through plaza between the two parts of the Wrigley Building, just off Michigan Avenue.
data.disclaimers: Offered for a limited time as a seasonal "pop-up" tour. Runs rain or shine; may be canceled with notice for particularly unpleasant weather.
